decision: The project owner reviewed the spoken-order evaluation and accepted the synthetic evaluation as sufficient for the controlled demonstration of this final-year project, and authorised activation of the spoken-order interpreter (switch order_fallback) for that demonstration. Independent human-authored testing was WAIVED for the demonstration. It was NOT carried out.
decided_by: Ruhan Kamran, project owner (statement made in the project conversation of 26 Oct 2026, UTC; the exact time was not recorded)
limitations_accepted: all sentences and labels were written by one AI assistant: shared habits of wording are possible, and the set is small (one row is 0.7 points)

the four incorrect interpretations were vague sentences answered with the most plausible item instead of a question; two involved a glucose or a rescue drug; each was only a read-back that the trainee's own yes releases
the contexts were short text, not the live engine state
still_required_before_real_trainee_use: the institution's approval, the trainee's own consent for cloud processing (ADR-0027), privacy review, and a human-authored evaluation set (EX-18) or an explicit new decision by the institution
safeguards_unchanged: the trainee's own yes before anything is executed (signed, single-use, per-user confirmation ticket)
approved action catalogue and intent-kind validation
ambiguous and incomplete sentences become a question
institutional approval and personal consent before a trainee's words go to the cloud; local fallback otherwise
